entry.title: STUDY WITH ME (without music): 2 hours pomodoro session

media:group.media:title: STUDY WITH ME (without music): 2 hours pomodoro session
media:group.media:description:
Studying for my in training exam (ITE) in emergency medicine. Let’s study together! If you’re new, we usually get some work done using the pomodoro technique. The concept is simple. First, pick a task that needs to be done. Then we set the pomodoro timer (in this video we’re using 25 minutes) and begin working on the task. After each pomodoro session, we’ll take a 5 minute break.
